title: Mobile equipment operations
body: Refuelling and boarding are where small habits turn into fires, falls and equipment damage at ADW. The refuelling area has already produced four separate near-miss and overflow events, all with the same gap: nobody supervising the basics.
keyPoints: Refuelling: engine off, ignition off, key out before the nozzle goes in. No smoking, no open flames and no phone in use inside the demarcated zone.
Spill control is part of the job, not a backup. Drip trays and absorbent material in place, and you know the spill response before you need it.
Boarding: three points of contact every time. Face the machine, never jump, and don't carry items in your hands. Use a lanyard or the cab hoist.
Dozing: doze in 1st gear and return in 2nd. Come to a full stop before changing from forward to reverse, and steer with blade tilt when the blade is loaded.
apply: Before your first fuel stop, check the North Go-Line refuelling point: engine off, a spotter or attendant in place, and drip trays down. That bay has had queues and supply delays recently, and that's when steps get skipped.
